topic: mobile board zoom and pan arrows
currentUserGoal: Make grass tiles larger on mobile and add touchscreen pan arrows around the board so players can scroll the zoomed field.
changesMade: Added an expanded-mobile board zoom multiplier so mobile fields that use the wide viewport no longer fall back to desktop scale.
Kept compact non-expanded mobile boards clamped to fit while zooming expanded fields to require natural panning.
Added four pooled Phaser canvas pan controls on the board edge for mobile portrait: up, down, left, and right.
Arrow controls pan through the existing boardPanX/boardPanY path via panBoardByFieldTiles, preserving culling, clamping, dirty tile behavior, and world-map marker updates.
Arrow controls support press-and-hold repeat and fade/disable at board edges.
Bumped the mobile test URL version to soft-mobile-audio-2-board-pan-1.
verificationRun: npm run build passed after the board changes.
Browser visual check at 390x844 on http://127.0.0.1:5173/?fieldShape=rect64&mobileTest=audio&v=board-pan-arrows-2 showed larger tiles and all four edge arrows.
Browser click check tapped the right edge arrow at 390x844; the board panned, the right arrow faded at the edge, and no grass touch was fired.
Browser visual check at 390x844 on http://127.0.0.1:5173/?fieldShape=rect25&mobileTest=audio&v=board-pan-arrows-1 showed compact fields still fit with larger readable tiles and no unnecessary arrows.

Mobile perf harness at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?perfHarness&tiles=1200 completed with frameSpikes=0, layoutPasses=0, redraws=0, redrawQueued=0, tileMode=viewport, visibleTiles from 56 down to 36, displayObjects from 369 to 392, and activeTweens from 11 to 25 across phases.
npm run build passed again after bumping MOBILE_TEST_URL_VERSION to soft-mobile-audio-2-board-pan-1.
currentGitStatus: Pre-existing unrelated untracked files still present and untouched: docs/GAME_SYSTEMS_REFERENCE CLAUDE.md, Dutch automation docs, docs/artifacts/title-art-2026-06-19/, docs/grasstouching.mid, docs/lucid.aif, handoffs/HANDOFF_2026-06-20_POST_PUSH_WORKFLOW_TEST.json
knownIssues: The exact comfort level of the new mobile zoom should still be judged on real iPhone Safari and Android Chrome.
The arrows intentionally overlay the board edge; if they feel too visually loud on a real phone, reduce BOARD_PAN_CONTROL_SIZE alpha or move them further into the border.
The local Vite server was used for verification and should be stopped before final handoff if no longer needed.
nextRecommendedSteps: Deploy to production and test https://grasstouchingsimulator.com/?mobileTest=audio&v=soft-mobile-audio-2-board-pan-1 on a real phone.
Check whether tapping and holding each arrow feels natural, especially near field edges.
If the field feels too zoomed on mid-game phones, reduce MOBILE_BOARD_EXPANDED_ZOOM slightly from 1.92.
If vertical scrolling still appears too late for some organic field shapes, consider a shape-aware minimum zoom for fields with both width and height near the expanded threshold.
doNotRevert: Do not remove the readable two-row mobile dock from the previous handoff.
Do not restore expanded mobile boards to desktop scale; that caused tiny tiles in the user's phone screenshot.
Do not replace the arrow controls with DOM buttons outside the canvas unless the board layout is redesigned around them.
Do not touch or remove the unrelated untracked docs/assets listed in git status.
